content:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT 4781122333 - continuous-batch node group 'cb-prod-eu' CPU and tail-latency spike detected. p99 > 2.5s, errors rising. Auto-pager to oncall-sre.

sam: saw this, I'm on it. any initial impact details?

maria: dashboards show KV cache evictions skyrocketing around 4781122000, microbatch sizes jumped to 16 for some routers (should be 4). looks like prefetch/optimiser rollout from last night.

jon: confirmed. rollout id r-2026-03-14-batch-opt applied 02:12 UTC. config set microbatch_max=16 and prefetch_window_ms=200.

lee: that matches. continuous-batching combined with high concurrency produced huge KV cache pressure -> eviction storm -> cache misses -> more prefetch -> self-reinforcing loop.

sam: impact? any customer-facing errors?

cust-success: AcmePay and NimbusRetail reporting slow response times and timeouts. estimating ~6% of paid requests affected in EU region. screenshots in the ticket.

anna: telemetry: p95 went from 120ms to 1.4s, p99 to 2.7s. error rate (5xx) from 0.02% to 1.8% in last 10m. circuit-breaker tripped in some dedicated pools.

sam: ok mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout / roll back batch-opt 2) reduce microbatch_max_size to 4 3) set kv_cache_eviction to aggressive (lower TTL) 4) temporarily throttle new large-prefetch requests 5) pager update + customer comms.

maria: agree. I'll pause rollout now.

jon: I'm rolling back r-2026-03-14-batch-opt -> previous stable (r-2026-03-13). running: 
```
# rollback command
./deployctl rollout revert --id r-2026-03-14-batch-opt --env prod --group cb-prod-eu
```

lee: I'll patch runtime config to force smaller microbatch cap and lower prefetch window:
```
{
  "continuous_batching": {
    "microbatch_max_size": 4,
    "prefetch_window_ms": 40,
    "adaptive_prefetch": false
  },
  "kv_cache": {
    "eviction_policy": "aggressive",
    "max_entries": 250000
  }
}
```

sam: jon + lee, apply safely with canary 10% then 100% if green. i'll hold throttle changes until we see improvement.

ops-bot: canary rollout started: patch-config-cb-4781122380 -> 10% hosts.

(2m later)

maria: partial improvement on canary. p95 down to ~300ms on canary hosts, evictions decreasing.

sam: start scaling canary to 30%. watch KV eviction rate and p99.

(5m later)

j on: canary 30% -> 70% then global. current plan: finish at 4781122870.

anna: metrics: global p95 230ms, p99 420ms, errors down to 0.15%. still some hotspots in dedicated pools in zone eu-west-2.

sam: we need to confirm no customer data loss. any retries or duplicate writes?

cust-success: AcmePay reported a few idempotent retries; no confirmed duplicates. they're asking for ETA on full recovery.

sam: ETA 20m assuming no regression. will prepare incident summary and CS note.

lee: also adding short-term guard in router: if microbatch >8 then reject with 429 and instruct client to backoff. small patch: 
```
# router guard
if request.microbatch_hint > 8:
  return 429, {
    "error":"microbatch-too-large",
    "retry_after": 2
  }
```

jon: guard deployed to edge 10% then 100% (non-disruptive).

(10m later)

anna: full rollback complete, config stabilized. KV evictions at baseline. all latency and error metrics within normal.

sam: excellent. fast postmortem TODOs: 1) revert default microbatch from 8->4 in central config to avoid future rollouts making it 16 2) add rollout gating for prefetch window changes 3) add regression test that simulates high concurrency + cache stress 4) customer follow-up note draft + credits if needed.

maria: I'll own test and gating changes.

jon: I'll attach rollout logs and exact command timeline to the incident doc.

cust-success: I'll draft a brief message to AcmePay + NimbusRetail, include mitigation steps and ETA; ask for affected user lists.

sam: handing off to anna for overnight watch and postmortem. I'm going offline in 10.

anna: ack, taking handoff. I'll keep 30m watch and then hand to next oncall. leaving a slack reminder in #incidents.

sam: thanks everyone :thumbsup: closing pager.

ops-bot: incident 4781122333 - status: mitigated -> monitoring. postmortem ticket: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-4781122333

pagerbot: Reminder: please file an incident summary in the tracker and tag infra/serving, eng-oncall.

anna: filing now. TL;DR in subject: high-concurrency continuous-batch prefretch + microbatch-cap rollback + guard -> mitigated.

(anna adds handoff note)

anna: handoff notes: observed pattern: prefetch_window increased + microbatch_max_size increase led to KV cache spill -> eviction storm -> latency cliff. mitigation worked: rollback rollout, reduce microbatch cap, aggressive eviction, router guard. continuing monitor for 2 hours.

sam: leaving, good job. :rocket:
